# WRITE A FRONTIER RESUME [italic]Your resume is the first thing an employer reads, and often the only thing, because it arrives three months before you do.[/italic]
## KEEP IT SHORT One page. Employers on the frontier read resumes on a terminal with a cracked screen during a power cut. Put the important part at the top. The important part is that you are still alive.
## LIST YOUR HYPERSLEEP Long gaps in your work history are normal out here. Explain them. Hypersleep, 2179 to 2180 is fine. Hypersleep, can not remember is fine too. A gap that says do not ask is not fine and will be asked about.
## SKILLS EMPLOYERS WANT - Fixing things with the wrong part. - Working nights without talking about what you saw. - Getting on with Working Joes. They are on most colonies, and they remember who was rude. - Operating a power loader, a drill or a crawler. Ideally not all at once. - Reading a contract. Very rare. Very valuable. Some employers will not hire you for it.
## SKILLS EMPLOYERS DO NOT WANT - Union organising. - Asking about the specimen handler listing. - Any experience at all with the lower levels of a processor.
## REFERENCES Give two. A supervisor and a colleague. If both of them are on colonies that are not answering, give two more. Indentured understands. Indentured has seen a lot of resumes with that problem lately.
